entries.ab103f127347d490: It focuses on the aftermarket for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and, in addition to its parts sales and repair services and equipment sales services, aims to expand its service areas, including sales of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and ancillary facilities and maintenance after installation. entries.c1cda6ec1cd12836: It provides a parts sales and repair service for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, and an equipment sales service that purchases used equipment and supports its sale. Through the cross-border EC site “LAYLA-EC,” it aggregates equipment and parts information from around the world and combines it with the technical capabilities of its field engineers.
entries.c426a47f861d3d19: This is the only reportable segment of the company group, consisting of the company and one consolidated subsidiary (TMH KOREA Inc.). Its main business is the sale and repair of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and parts. It combines a mechanism that aggregates information on equipment and parts worldwide through the cross-border EC site 'LAYLA-EC' with engineering capabilities, such as dismantling, removal and installation of equipment by field engineers, and supports the operation of semiconductor factories mainly in the domestic market, where many semiconductor plants are older models. Revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥8,628 million.
